sources.title: Tessera: Next Concept Prediction, gated and scaled - a yava-code Collection
sources.snippet: A 135M overfit gate, then a token-matched 1B comparison. The decoder uses the concept channel at both scales; the token verdict at 1B is neutral.

sources.title: GitHub - gstoner/tessera: Tessera Deep Learning Programing Model
sources.snippet: Tessera is a standalone, tile-oriented programming model and compiler for deep learning and scientific computing. It makes layout, memory ownership, numerical policy and parallel execution explicit compiler contracts.
